QF.id: I Clearing Settlement and Risk Management_40

question.text: Only FPIs (Foreign Portfolio Investors) are permitted to offer which type of collateral?

answer.text: Foreign sovereign securities with AAA ratings

explanation.text: The Logic: Page 178 of the NISM Series I Currency Derivatives workbook (December 2025) states that only FPIs are permitted to offer foreign sovereign securities with AAA ratings as eligible collateral. Other market participants cannot use foreign sovereign securities for this purpose. The Trap: Gold, corporate bonds, and real estate are not the FPI-only collateral category referred to on page 178; the rule specifically identifies AAA-rated foreign sovereign securities. Note: The rationale that this rule accommodates FPIs because their assets may be predominantly in foreign securities is not stated on page 178 and is not used here.
